title: Strapi Content Entry
description: Represents a content entry in the Strapi headless CMS. Content entries are instances of content-types and contain the field values defined by the content-type schema. In Strapi 5, entry attributes are directly accessible at the first level of the data object (flattened response format).

id.description: The unique integer identifier for the content entry

documentId.description: The unique document identifier for the content entry, used as the primary key in REST API operations

createdAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the entry was created

updatedAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the entry was last updated

publishedAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the entry was published, or null if the entry is in draft status. Only present when Draft and Publish is enabled on the content-type.

locale.description: The locale code of the entry (e.g., en, fr, de). Only present when internationalization (i18n) is enabled on the content-type.

localizations.description: An array of localized versions of this entry. Only present when internationalization is enabled and the populate parameter includes localizations.

ContentTypeSchema.title: Content Type Schema
ContentTypeSchema.description: Defines the structure of a content-type in Strapi, including its display name, kind, and attribute definitions.

displayName.description: The human-readable display name of the content-type shown in the admin panel

singularName.description: The singular name used internally and in the API identifier

pluralName.description: The plural name used in REST API route paths

kind.description: Whether this content-type is a collection (multiple entries) or single (one entry)

draftAndPublish.description: Whether Draft and Publish is enabled for this content-type

attributes.description: The field definitions for the content-type, keyed by attribute name

Attribute.title: Content Type Attribute
Attribute.description: Defines a single field attribute within a content-type schema.

type.description: The data type of the attribute

unique.description: Whether this field must have unique values

private.description: Whether this field is hidden from API responses

default.description: The default value for this field

minLength.description: Minimum character length for string-type fields

maxLength.description: Maximum character length for string-type fields

multiple.description: Whether multiple files are allowed for media-type fields

allowedTypes.description: Allowed file types for media-type fields

relation.description: The relation type for relation-type fields

target.description: The target content-type UID for relation-type fields

component.description: The component UID for component-type fields

repeatable.description: Whether the component is repeatable (array of components)

components.description: Allowed component UIDs for dynamic zone fields

PaginationMeta.title: Pagination Metadata
PaginationMeta.description: Pagination information returned with list responses from the Strapi REST API.

pageSize.description: The number of entries per page

total.description: The total number of entries matching the query

ErrorResponse.title: Error Response
ErrorResponse.description: The standard error response format returned by Strapi APIs when a request fails.

status.description: The HTTP status code of the error

name.description: The error type name (e.g., ValidationError, NotFoundError, ForbiddenError)

message.description: A human-readable description of the error

details.description: Additional error details, such as validation errors per field
